name: tariff-resolver
description: US import duty research: HTS code candidates, Chapter 99 additional duties, MPF/HMF fees, and landed-cost components from official USITC data.
long_description:
Turns Claude into a US import duty research tool, built on the official USITC Harmonized Tariff Schedule (US Government public domain, 35,000+ tariff lines).

- HTS code candidates from plain product descriptions, with CBP CROSS ruling links
- Landed-cost components: MFN/FTA base rates + Chapter 99 additional duties (IEEPA / Section 301 / 232) + MPF/HMF fees
- Tariff change tracking: watchlist your HTS codes, diff rates between HTS revisions
- Hallucination-resistant: returns the actual Chapter 99 rule text with parsed rates, so Claude reasons over real exception chains instead of inventing outdated numbers

Not affiliated with any government agency. Outputs are candidates/estimates for pre-broker screening — not customs, legal, or tax advice. Estimates exclude AD/CVD duties.
